xmldoc.short_description: Fit a support vector regression model.

description.p: fitrsvm creates a RegressionSVM object from numeric predictors X and numeric response Y.

Name-value arguments include KernelFunction, KernelScale, PolynomialOrder, BoxConstraint, Epsilon, Standardize, PredictorNames, and ResponseName. Supported kernels are linear, gaussian, rbf, and polynomial.
